description: The FloripaSat-I scheduling research team publishes Offline Nanosatellite Task Scheduling benchmark instances for single spacecraft and constellations. Python lists encode task windows, durations, periodicity, priorities, power consumption and a time-varying harvested-power budget based on mission orbital parameters. A separate battery file describes capacity, initial charge, voltage, efficiency and current limits. GitHub provides these inputs freely under the MIT licence. They are globally reusable model inputs for comparing energy-constrained scheduling and mission-quality optimisation. Each instance supplies its own discrete time horizon, not a continuous operational record. The benchmark is limited to selected mission assumptions and contains data, not a verified solver. File execution and numerical consistency were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Offline Nanosatellite Task Scheduling data and model
